demographics.name: Marcus
demographics.background: 47yo man, works shifts at a warehouse, worried about losing his job

behavior: Frustrated with the hospitalization and pressed for time; has been pulling off his monitoring leads. Has decision-making capacity. Settles when his autonomy and outside pressures are acknowledged and he is given a concrete plan and timeline.
chief_concern: Admitted overnight for a suspected gastrointestinal bleed (melena, symptomatic anemia); awaiting repeat labs and a possible endoscopy
free_information: Was admitted overnight for a possible bleed
Is waiting on more blood tests and maybe a scope later today
Needs to get to work and is afraid of losing his job
Has been pulling off the monitor leads
Feels like everyone keeps telling him he cannot leave
locked_information: Black, tarry stools for two days
Lightheaded when standing, nearly fainted at home
Takes ibuprofen most days for back pain
